segments.text: This is a native HTML slide deck, recorded by vac.
Each slide carries its own narration, so the deck is the single source for both the slides and the voiceover.
Narration lives in a data-vo attribute on each slide.
A pause directive adds a beat of silence after the slide.
This slide's narration comes from an aside element with the notes class, the same convention reveal.js uses for speaker notes.
To record, run vac html video with the deck as input.
It serves this folder on a local port, presses the right arrow once per slide, and times each slide to its own narration.
